title: Integrative network pharmacology and molecular dynamics analysis of Ceiba pentandra compounds with experimental support for colorectal cancer therapy
content:

Ceiba pentandra leaf extract exhibited potent, selective cytotoxicity in HCT-116 cells with good fibroblast compatibility. Key compounds also target AKT1, TP53, and STAT3, modulating PI3K-Akt signalling.
